expected_effects: Coordinate frame for the empty tray slot.
preconditions: Camera view covers both cup and tray.

expected_effects: Cup is lifted from the table.
Confirmation that the cup is securely held.
edges.trigger: If slip is detected, trigger recovery.

expected_effects: Cup is moved to the slot location.
Cup is lowered until contact with the tray.
Robot arm retracts from the tray area.
preconditions: Cup is supported by the tray slot.
Gripper is not under high load.

expected_effects: Visual confirmation that the green cup is in the gray tray.
Cup is safely placed back on the table.
edges.trigger: Slip detected or grasp force anomaly.

goal_interpretation: Identify the green cup and the gray tray with an empty slot, transport the cup to the slot, place it securely, and release the grasp.

nodes.description: Initial scene state with green cup and gray tray visible on the table.
observable_conditions: Green cup is visible on the table surface.
Gray tray is visible on the table surface.
unknown_conditions: Exact pose of the cup relative to the robot base.
Friction coefficient of the cup surface.

nodes.description: Visual confirmation of the green cup and identification of an empty slot in the gray tray.
observable_conditions: Empty slot in gray tray identified and localized.
unknown_conditions: Whether the slot dimensions perfectly fit the cup base.
Occlusion status of the slot from current camera angle.

nodes.description: Robot has successfully grasped the green cup and verified hold stability.
observable_conditions: Cup is lifted slightly off the table.
No slip detected during initial lift.
unknown_conditions: Internal stress on the cup material.

nodes.description: Green cup is positioned over the empty slot and lowered into contact with the tray.
observable_conditions: Cup is in contact with the tray slot.
Robot end-effector is still holding the cup lightly or just released.
unknown_conditions: Whether the cup is upright and stable in the slot.
Whether the cup interferes with adjacent slots.

nodes.description: Green cup is resting in the gray tray's empty slot, and the robot has released it.
observable_conditions: Robot gripper is open and retracted.
Cup remains stationary in the tray slot.
unknown_conditions: Final semantic verification of 'correct' placement if multiple slots exist.

objects.description: The target object to be moved, identified by its green color and cup shape.
The target container with specific slots for holding objects.
A specific vacant position within the gray tray suitable for placing the cup.

physical_checks: Verify the green cup is not too heavy for the gripper payload limit.
Check if the gray tray is fixed or sliding on the table surface.
Ensure the empty slot is large enough to accommodate the base of the green cup.
Confirm no other objects obstruct the path between the cup and the tray.
Verify the material of the cup allows for a stable friction grasp.
